contracts.evidence: export/rigged.rs:23-34 removes UV-bearing surface pair. surface stores only borrowed ShellTextures; texcoords is the sole optional per-position column. All actual surface assignments found at the exact revision are maps-only. No compatibility alias or stale-UV fallback remains.

export.rs:600 calls validate before CompactShell::new or buffer publication. validation.rs:51-70 checks both surface maps nonempty, either map family requires texcoords, and any supplied texcoords must be finite and position-sized. Both missing and mismatched columns fail before compactor indexing. Untextured shells can still omit UVs.

export/compact.rs:24-74 derives sorted used vertices from validated faces and uses the same order for geometry, texcoords, skin and morphs. rigged():85-108 returns self.texcoords.as_deref(), while carrying only source.surface maps; no unremapped source UV can be recovered by the writer.

export/shell.rs:53-60 reads only shell.texcoords, serializes its rows via f32_bytes, and counts the same rows in TEXCOORD_0. apply_shell_textures still consumes only maps; existing map precedence, pointer-identity cache, samplers, PBR factors and standalone/shared file policies are unchanged.

character_morphs::rigged_armor sets texcoords to armor.texcoords for every component. Character catalog_shells and equipment armor attach only maps. Character trim explicitly selects SelectedTrim.texcoords before attaching maps. Mail, hair, textile and untextured clothing producers retain their existing sole-column routes. Public existing fixtures use maps-only plus explicit UVs.

RiggedShell surface and texcoords both borrow stable producer owners. CompactShell owns selected UVs and returns a borrow tied to self; ShellTextures remains borrowed from the source for synchronous export. No mutable or escaping UV reference is introduced. Face/skin/morph admission remains unchanged.

For existing matching UVs, map/image selection and all serialized f32 numerical rules are unchanged. Surface-only callers must now provide texcoords explicitly; no backward compatibility promise. Removing fallback fixes compact shells that formerly retained source-size UVs. When both map families are present, the existing override policy remains; this review does not claim a new multi-chart material feature.
